title: This Fish Weighs a Ton and Lays Up to 300 Million Eggs

scenes.text: This fish can lay up to three hundred million eggs.
It's the ocean sunfish, the heaviest bony fish in the world.
A typical adult is about six feet long and weighs about a ton.
The biggest one on record topped five thousand pounds.
No other known fish makes anywhere near that many eggs.
A flat floating giant, and the biggest egg layer of any fish.

description:
The ocean sunfish can produce up to 300 million eggs, many times more than any other known fish.
